title: Russian Overnight Drone Barrage Kills 7 in Kyiv, Including 14-Year-Old Boy, Injures 59
detail: Russia struck Kyiv overnight into September 25 with a mass drone and missile barrage hitting at least six districts and the surrounding area. At least 7 people were killed, including two children — among them a 14-year-old Israeli citizen whose mother was also injured — and 59 people were injured, with 25 hospitalized. A 16-story residential building was struck in the Pecherskyi district; a commercial building was hit in Podilskyi; an office building, a medical facility and drone debris caused damage in Solomianskyi; a five-story non-residential building caught fire in Shevchenkivskyi, damaging Ukraine's High Council of Justice building nearby and injuring 8 people; a McDonald's warehouse was hit in Brovary, Kyiv Oblast; and data centers were damaged in Lutsk, disrupting public transport systems there. President Zelenskyy said Russia is "constantly expanding their escalation operation" by targeting businesses, data centers and internet providers.

title: Ukraine Strikes Perm Oil Refinery 1,450km Inside Russia, Ulyanovsk Missile-Parts Plant and Voronezh Rubber Plant
detail: Ukrainian long-range drones struck at least four Russian regions overnight on September 25: the Lukoil-Permnefteorgsintez oil refinery in Perm Krai, roughly 1,450 km from the Ukrainian border, catching fire and killing 1 person; the Iskra plant in Ulyanovsk (~800 km from the border), part of the Almaz-Antey defense conglomerate and a supplier of components for Kh-59M2 guided missiles, injuring 8 people including a child; the Voronezhsintezkauchuk synthetic rubber and rocket-propellant plant in Voronezh, injuring 13 people including a child and damaging nearby apartment building facades and vehicles; and the Novoshakhtinsk oil products plant in Rostov Oblast, which halted operations after a fire with no casualties reported. Russia's Defense Ministry said it intercepted 592 Ukrainian drones overnight across the affected regions, occupied Crimea and the Black Sea.

title: Russian Drones Hit Medical Center and Ambulances in Zaporizhzhia
detail: Russian drones struck Zaporizhzhia city in a morning attack on September 25, hitting a medical center that caught fire and sustained structural damage; rescuers extinguished the blaze after evacuating seven patients from multiple floors, including people with reduced mobility. Emergency medical service vehicles parked nearby were also struck, though no one in them was injured. One person sustained minor injuries in the wider attack, which also damaged non-residential buildings, garage-cooperative vehicles and residential building windows, according to Zaporizhzhia Regional Defense Council co-chair Ivan Fedorov.
